title: Online play
description: The native engines already include their multiplayer clients. Prepare local files and settings here; account approval and any operating-system firewall prompt stay with you.

openra.title: OpenRA multiplayer
steps: Prepare the local profile below, then use the main Play button.
In the game, choose Multiplayer and join a public server. No separate multiplayer client is required.
Use the same engine release and mod version as your friends. Original Windows C&C clients cannot join OpenRA games.
openra.hosting: Hosting uses TCP port 1234. You can explicitly enable automatic UPnP/NAT-PMP discovery below. If your router does not support it, manual forwarding or a reachable dedicated server may be needed. Joining public servers does not require this option.

generals.title: GeneralsOnline / NGMP
steps: Prepare the local profile below, then use the main Play button.
In the game, open online multiplayer and complete the provider's browser sign-in if requested. Credentials never go into this launcher.
Your friends need a compatible GeneralsX/GeneralsOnline build and the same mod/data version. This is not a promise of compatibility with every original Windows client or mod.
generals.hosting: The pinned engine includes the online client. No GameSpy installer, Windows DLL injection or router changes are performed by this launcher. Joining and hosting still need a real multiplayer test on your network.

hostingLabel: Enable automatic router discovery for OpenRA hosting
resultNote: Local preparation is not proof of authentication, NAT reachability or a successful match. Firewall approval and browser login cannot be completed for you.
